final: WITH per_trans_avg AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) as trans_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals WHERE anlycount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY transref), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(trans_avg) as overall_avg FROM per_trans_avg), filtered AS (SELECT pta.transref, pta.trans_avg, (pta.trans_avg - oa.overall_avg) as above_overall FROM per_trans_avg pta CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE pta.trans_avg > oa.overall_avg), kept_avg AS (SELECT AVG(trans_avg) as kept_transactions_avg FROM filtered), final AS (SELECT f.transref, f.trans_avg, f.above_overall, (f.trans_avg - ka.kept_transactions_avg) as above_kept FROM filtered f CROSS JOIN kept_avg ka) SELECT transref, trans_avg, above_overall, above_kept FROM final ORDER BY above_kept DESC, transref ASC LIMIT 10
